summary: Diff adds a new Motoko backend canister skeleton (token + proposal/voting structures) and a React frontend with wallet (Internet Identity), token transfer/balance UI, proposal create/list/detail UI, treasury balance panel, and a warm wood-inspired theme. However, several backend acceptance criteria (stable persistence, treasury mechanics, proposal execution/quorum/status APIs) and required static image assets are not evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Token balances persist across canister upgrades (stable state).
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows balances as an in-memory Map and does not show any stable variables or preupgrade/postupgrade hooks to persist balances across upgrades.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend supports listing proposals and fetching a proposal by id, including current vote totals and status (active/accepted/rejected/executed/expired).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend expects actor methods like getAllProposals() and getProposal(), but the backend diff excerpt only shows createProposal and voteProposal; proposal listing/detail query methods and explicit status computation are not evidenced in the truncated backend snippet.

missing_requirements.requirement: Quorum/threshold rules are implemented and documented in-code and reflected in proposal status computation.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend status logic uses a simple rule (yesVotes > noVotes and totalVotes > 0) and no quorum/threshold constants or documentation are evidenced in backend/main.mo excerpt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Proposal finalization/execution is enforced (cannot execute unless accepted; cannot execute twice) and governance state persists across upgrades (stable state).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls a finalize/execution mutation (useFinalizeProposal), but the backend excerpt does not show any finalize/execute method; also proposals and votes are stored in non-stable Maps with no upgrade persistence shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend maintains a DAO treasury token balance owned/controlled by the canister and exposes a query to read it.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo only shows var treasuryBalance = 0 and does not evidence a getTreasuryBalance() query, while the frontend expects actor.getTreasuryBalance().

missing_requirements.requirement: Accepted proposals of type “treasury transfer” can be executed on-chain, moving tokens from treasury to recipient and marking proposal executed.
missing_requirements.reason: createProposal checks amount > treasuryBalance (initially 0) and no on-chain execution/treasury transfer function is evidenced in backend/main.mo excerpt; Proposal has an executed flag but no execution logic is shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames and are referenced as static assets in the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: UI references the required filenames, but the diff summary does not show the actual asset files under frontend/public/assets/generated (one added file was omitted due to limits, so presence cannot be confirmed).

hallucinated_features.description: Use of next-themes ThemeProvider and a light/dark theme system.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest asks for a coherent visual theme but does not request a theme toggle/system; this appears as an extra implementation detail.
